Name: Mitsui Looks Farmer texture
Author: zurakazura
Description:
让你的角色也能穿三井寿的衣服，扔篮球和用拖把割草，CP模式：

[list=1]
[*]需要[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]和[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[*]包含两种体型，修改了鞋和微调了身体细节（只修改了男体型）
[*]以及把炸弹改成篮球
[*]镰刀改成拖把
[/list]
*可以使用通用模组配置菜单（Generic Mod Config Menu）切换体型或者关闭贴图修改。

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A CP mod for Mitsui looks:

[list=1]
[*]Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[*]Includes two farmer body textures.（It only changes the male farmer）
[*]Replaces bombs with basketballs.
[*]Replaces scythes with mops.
[/list]
*You can use the Generic Mod Config Menu to change farmer body or turn off texture modifications.
